banner.publicMap: Publicly shared map — view only, changes are not saved
banner.mapChanged: Someone else has changed this map in the meantime.

conflict.title: This map was changed in the meantime
conflict.body: Someone else edited this map (or you did, in another window). Choose what to do — nothing is discarded without your say.
conflict.reloadHint: “Load current version” discards the edits drafted in this window.
conflict.keepMineHint: “Keep my changes” saves your version — the other person's edits get overwritten.
conflict.keepFailed: Saving failed — the map may have changed again. Please try once more.

toolbar.alignTitle: Arrange the map — the button shows the style currently on the map; click switches to the next one (wide → compact → around center). Press and hold to lock the style for every map.
toolbar.fitViewTitle: Zoom out to the whole map
toolbar.alignLockedTitle: Arrange the map — style „{{styl}}" is LOCKED on your account, so maps open in it on your other devices too (including maps with hand-placed nodes). Click releases the lock and switches to the next style.
toolbar.readabilityTitle: Text size in nodes — the button shows the level currently applied; pressing switches to the next one (normal → larger → title only). Nodes stay where they are and nothing is written to the map.

controls.lockLockedTitle: Nodes locked — tap to unlock dragging

empty.start: Start by adding your first goal

toasts.mapNotSavedDesc: Save the map first (add some content).
toasts.mapSavedDesc: The template has been saved to your maps.
toasts.mapFromTemplateDesc: Created from the clean template — anything you tried in the preview is not carried over.
toasts.saveMapFailed: The map could not be saved.
toasts.archivedDesc: You'll find it on the Archive page.
toasts.allDoneDesc: All goals in this project are complete. Would you like to move it to the archive?
toasts.structureAddedDesc: {{count}} goals were added to the map.
toasts.aiInvalidResponse: Invalid response from the AI advisor.
toasts.nodeImprovedDesc: The AI updated the node's text.
toasts.aiConnectionError: Could not reach the AI advisor.
toasts.aiTimeout: We are sorry — we are working on a fix. Please try again later.
toasts.opsAppliedDesc: {{count}} operations were applied to the map.
toasts.mapMergedStatus: An automation completed a goal in the meantime — the map is up to date.
toasts.mapMergedRule: A rule updated the map in the meantime — you have the latest version.
toasts.alignLockedDesc: Applies on your phone too. Saved maps are not modified.
toasts.alignUnlockedDesc: Maps are no longer realigned on their own.

nodeDialog.title: Edit goal
nodeDialog.iconDesc: Shown in the map and in the table instead of the default icon.
nodeDialog.dlRequestApproveTitle: Saves the goal with the proposed due date
nodeDialog.deadlineOwnerOnly: Only the assigner ({{email}}) can change the due date.
nodeDialog.removeAssignerOnly: Only the assigner ({{email}}) can remove a goal with an assigned task.
nodeDialog.descriptionPlaceholder: Describe the goal in more detail...
nodeDialog.waitSwitchDesc: Until every goal under this node is done, the node waits (⏳) — e.g. for a material price.
nodeDialog.stashTitle: Move the node from the map to your personal stash
nodeDialog.deleteTitle: Delete the node from the map
nodeDialog.openMapTitle: Zoom to the node in the map
nodeDialog.executorHint: The assignee stays human — even for an automation it is the assignee who gets notified.

runStatus.retryHint: Restart it by switching the goal to “In progress”.

nodeDialog.automationNameHint: A record of what already runs here. If the name matches an agent in the registry, killBottleneck can start it itself.
nodeDialog.automationNameUnknown: This agent is not in the registry yet — the step won't run on its own until you create it there. To just note it down, switch on "I'd like this automated".
nodeDialog.automationWantedHint: Lets the AI agent managers know. They decide whether to build it.
nodeDialog.automationNotePlaceholder: Optional: why it slows you down today…

files.label: Attachments
files.triggersAutomation: Uploading a file starts the automation “{{name}}” right away.
files.linkFailed: The link could not be saved.
files.uploadsOff: This instance does not store uploaded files — attachments are added as links. Your file stays where it is and everyone works on the current version.

org.kindHint_position: A position is defined by the company structure (quality manager, head of production…).
org.kindHint_function: A person is appointed to a function (internal auditor, product safety officer…).
org.holderHint: Who holds this position/function. One person can hold several.
org.deputyHint: Who covers for the holder of THIS position — automation rules resolve it at run time. A different person may cover the same person's other position.
org.conflict: The holder and the deputy cannot be the same person.

saveTemplate.title: Save as template
saveTemplate.descPlaceholder: E.g. Standard procedure for handling a new inquiry…
saveTemplate.numberingDesc: the next number in the series is appended to the name
saveTemplate.numberingHint: Projects name themselves: "{{name}} {{year}}-1", "{{name}} {{year}}-2"… A new year starts a new series from 1. A custom name given at creation gets a number too.
saveTemplate.weeklySuffix: a new project is created in the morning
saveTemplate.monthlySuffix: of the month — a new project is created in the morning
saveTemplate.footerProcess: The template also stores responsible people, waiting switches and deadlines — those are converted to "days from start" (counted from today). When the template is used, you pick a start date and the deadlines are recalculated.
saveTemplate.footerPlain: The goal structure is saved (nodes and their links). Sticky notes are not carried over into the template.
saveTemplate.savedPersonalDesc: "{{name}}" is visible only to you (personal template).
saveTemplate.savedOrgDesc: "{{name}}" is now available to the whole organization.

buffer.heading: Stash
buffer.emptyHint: Jot down an idea — you'll see it in every map.
buffer.dragHint: Drag an idea onto the canvas, or use the arrow.

fromText.sourcePlaceholder: Paste notes, thoughts, or a call transcript…

advisor.questionsIntro: The AI asked follow-up questions to structure the goals better:

shareDialog.title: Share map
shareDialog.description: Access is tied to the e-mail — your colleague will see the map after registering with the same address.
shareDialog.permWorkTitle: Additionally opens the detail of every step and can ask for a due-date change even on others' work. Still switches status only on their own work.
shareDialog.permEditTitle: Co-manager: edits the map and can share it with others.
shareDialog.permReadTitle: Views the map and comments. On their own work they switch status and can ask for a different due date; they don't touch other steps.
shareDialog.teamWorkersHeader: Have work here via team access
shareDialog.teamWorkersDesc: Not in the list above — they see the map because it's enabled for the whole organization, and they own a step or task on it.
shareDialog.hasWorkNoteTitle: Owns or is assigned a step — they can check off their own step even with view-only access.
shareDialog.teamDesc: All team members will see the map
shareDialog.publicDesc: Anyone who can reach this installation's address (LAN/VPN) will see the map

node.timerStart: Start time tracking on this goal
node.descriptionHidden: Description hidden for larger text — hover to see it in full
node.assignedNoDelete: A goal with an assigned task cannot be removed
node.assignedNoDeleteHint: Only the assigner ({{email}}) or the project owner can remove a task with a due date from the map.
node.workOwnOnlyHint: As a collaborator you can change status only on goals where you are the responsible person.
node.deadlineRequestBadgeHint: A due date change to {{date}} was proposed — the assigner resolves it in the goal detail.
node.apexNoDelete: The main node cannot be deleted
node.apexNoDeleteHint: You can rename it (pencil / double-click). Only the whole project can be deleted, from the home page.
node.confirmDelete: Delete goal “{{title}}” from the map? Any subgoals stay and get detached.
node.confirmStash: Move goal “{{title}}” to the idea stash? It leaves the map; bring it back by inserting it from the stash.
node.connectMultiParentHint: Every goal has one place in the map. Detach it from its current parent first, then hang it here.
node.connectCycleHint: A goal cannot be its own parent — not even several steps away. The map could no longer be drawn.
node.connectSelf: A goal cannot connect to itself
node.connectSelfHint: A connection always goes from a parent goal to a child, never back around.
node.mapBroken: This map has a broken connection
node.mapBrokenHint: It contains a loop, or a goal hangs in several places, which breaks the layout. Repair detaches {{count}} extra connection(s) — the goals stay and you can undo it.
node.ruleBadgeHint: An automation rule targets this node — details in the node window, overview under the toolbar bolt
node.recurrenceBadgeHint: This goal repeats — when completed it returns with the deadline advanced

aiChat.emptyHint: The AI suggests changes you can confirm.

aiAgents.title: AI agent registry
aiAgents.description: Automations that can perform a process step. Nodes reference an agent by name — team members never see the URL or the key.
aiAgents.empty: No agents yet. Add the first one below.
aiAgents.noSecret: Without a secret the request is signed with an empty key — please set one.
aiAgents.nameHint: Nodes reference the agent by this name. It must be unique.
aiAgents.secretHint: killBottleneck signs the request body with it in the X-Signature header (HMAC-SHA256). It is never shown again.
aiAgents.contractDesc: When finished, POST run_id, run_token and status (done/failed), optionally result. That completes the node and hands over to the next step.
aiAgents.callbackLocalhost: This address points to localhost — an automation running elsewhere cannot reach it. Set KB_PUBLIC_URL in .env to the public address of this instance.
aiAgents.allowedHint: Separate e-mails with commas. Empty means anyone who can edit a map may run this automation.
aiAgents.allowedAll: Anyone on the team may run it

importMap.title: Import a project from JSON
importMap.description: Upload a file someone exported from killBottleneck. It becomes a new project.
importMap.hint: We accept killBottleneck exports (.json), Asana exports (CSV) and Trello exports (JSON). The file notifies nobody and shares the project with nobody.
importMap.badFormat: File not recognized — we accept killBottleneck (.json), Asana (CSV) and Trello (JSON) exports.
importMap.droppedAssignments_one: {{count}} assignment was dropped — that person is not here yet.
importMap.droppedAssignments_few: {{count}} assignments were dropped — those people are not here yet.
importMap.droppedAssignments_many: {{count}} assignments were dropped — those people are not here yet.
importMap.droppedAssignments_other: {{count}} assignments were dropped — those people are not here yet.
importMap.notSharedNote: We shared the project with nobody — if you are meant to collaborate on it, share it manually.
importMap.foreignTooBig: The file has {{count}} items — import handles at most {{max}}. Split the project into smaller parts.
importMap.fileTooLarge: The file is larger than 5 MB — import cannot handle that.

recurrence.label: Recurrence
recurrence.hint: When completed, the goal returns to To do by itself and the deadline advances in the rhythm of the original one — every Monday stays a Monday. Under the hood it is an ordinary rule; you will see it in the map's Rules.
recurrence.customHint: This goal's recurrence is driven by a manually edited rule — manage it in the map's Rules; the switch will not touch it.
